Contributing

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Work on a focused branch. From the repository root, install development dependencies with pak::pak(".", dependencies = TRUE) in R. Install devtools, callr, and cyclocomp for checks, and put Air 0.13.0 and Jarl 0.7.1 on your PATH.

Data types

Keep HCUP category codes numeric in DuckDB and derived binary indicators as BOOLEAN. Keep indicators logical in R, including after collection and in survey designs. Apply factor labels to multi-level codes at the R boundary with nis_label().

Verify a change

  • Before writing code, list what could fail. Prefer end-to-end tests of the public workflow with invented fixtures. Keep the inputs, exact command, platform, transcript, and observed results for each run. Follow AGENTS.md when a test needs isolation.
  • Run relevant tests with devtools::test(). Keep tests fast and safe to run in parallel. Put slow tests behind EASYNIS_FULL_TESTS and keep CI on each push under 10 minutes.
  • If roxygen comments change, run devtools::document() and commit the generated changes. Use the roxygen2 version in DESCRIPTION.
  • Put changelog bullets in one unique news/<topic-slug>.md fragment. Leave NEWS.md for collection. An optional first ## heading must match a development section in NEWS.md.
  • Before committing, run Rscript --vanilla tools/check-package.R --lint for Air formatting, Jarl lint, and installed-package cyclomatic complexity of 15 or less.
  • Before opening the PR, run Rscript --vanilla tools/check-package.R --full. It runs devtools::check() on the exact commit with EASYNIS_FULL_TESTS enabled, isolated from the working tree and ignored data.

Describe what changed, how you verified it, and any remaining limitations in the PR template. See the improvement loop for orchestrated work and review.

Where changes belong

Package code lives in R/, with related tests in tests/testthat/.

To change Start here
Opening annual or Hive data R/open.R for the entry point, R/open-discovery.R for part ownership, R/open-parquet.R for scans, R/open-release.R for annual release checks, and R/duckdb.R for connections and spill storage
Diagnosis or procedure selection R/code-layout.R for slots and code systems, R/code-flags.R for matching, and R/procedure-days.R for PRDAY decoding
Survey design or weights R/design.R for input selection, R/design-sample.R for scans, R/cohort-design.R for survey objects, and R/reweight.R for reweighting
Disclosure R/disclosure-policy.R for policy, R/cell-counts.R for summaries, and R/suppress-survey.R or R/suppress-data-frame.R for masking
Generated studies R/study-scaffold.R for files, R/study-cache.R for caching, R/study-model.R for fit diagnostics, and inst/templates/nis-study/ for the report
Improvement probes tools/probe/quality-checks.R for checks, tools/probe/quality-receipts.R for evidence, and tools/probe/readiness-criteria.R for readiness

For scan planning or DuckDB workload changes, run the bounded scan check and spill benchmark.

Update CCSR mappings

Update the AHRQ CCSR mappings with Rscript --vanilla tools/update-ccsr.R <dx|pr> <version> <YYYY-MM-DD> <HCUP-URL> [local-file] [expected-codes] [expected-categories] [expected-pairs] for each release. The input can be the download URL, a local HCUP ZIP or workbook, or its mapping CSV. Use - for the local-file argument when downloading and checking published totals. Review the release index, verify the mapping diff and coverage, update the attribution, and open a pull request.

Privacy and licensing

Keep licensed HCUP inputs, real records, private paths, and local validation receipts out of the repository and public material. Never publish output from real-data runs, including estimates, counts, or any record-derived values, in issues, PRs, commits, or docs. Keep those outputs in Git-ignored local/loop/. Review tables for primary and complementary disclosure risks. Follow the HCUP Data Use Agreement and institutional requirements, and contribute independently authored code compatible with AGPL-3.0-only.

Before posting an issue or PR body, save the text locally and run Rscript --vanilla tools/check-public-text.R path/to/body.md. Check the text yourself for private material even when the scanner passes.
